fixes_applied_in_phase_5.summary: Config.AuthHeader() now prepends 'Token ' (Django REST Framework requires the literal scheme prefix). Without this, every API call returned 403 'Authentication credentials were not provided.'

Added cliutil.ResolveResellerID — derives the reseller ID from companies[0].reseller URL because /current-user/ does NOT expose reseller info on partner-scoped tokens. Env override: SERVOSITY_MSP_RESELLER_ID.
attention --refresh now hits /resellers/{id}/issues/ instead of /issues/ (admin-only). Stale-backup section now non-fatal: emits stderr warning and continues with empty stale data on 403.
triage list mode now hits /resellers/{id}/issues/ instead of /issues/. Per-issue mutation paths unchanged (work as-is once a valid ID is in hand).
unprovisioned now uses cliutil.ResolveResellerID instead of its own /current-user/-based resolver (which always failed because /current-user/ omits reseller_id).
bill / bill --reconcile now uses cliutil.ResolveResellerID for the same reason as unprovisioned.

stale-backups now emits a clean directive ('use backup-facts --since 7d instead') when /reports/stale-backup-sets/ returns 403 instead of a stack trace. v0.2 reshape will derive from local backup tables natively.
bill --reconcile <path> --dry-run no longer fails on missing CSV file — moved file-existence check after the dry-run short-circuit.

live_verification.notes: returns username/email/id; does NOT expose reseller_id (handled via /companies/ resolver)
